categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Tongye Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the rail transit locomotive and vehicle electrical equipment sector, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and maintenance services of electrical products. Its main product categories include power supply products, intelligent control products, motors and fans, and related accessories. The company also provides repair and maintenance services for rail transit electrical equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced power electronics technologies including IGBT, MOSFET, and SiC devices for its power supply products, employing high-frequency switching and modular designs. Intelligent control products incorporate hot standby redundancy technology and IEC61131-3 standard-based distributed network control to ensure safety and reliability. Motors and fans are designed for high insulation, long mechanical life, and low failure rates, with recent developments in permanent magnet synchronous motors and EC fans for higher efficiency and intelligence. Production is managed through ERP and PMC systems with a focus on quality control and efficient supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major rail transit operators and manufacturers such as China CRRC Group, China National Railway Group, and various regional railway bureaus and metro companies. The products serve markets including mainline railways, high-speed rail, urban rail transit (metro, light rail), and new energy rail vehicles. The company also exports products to over ten countries across Asia, Europe, and South America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a marketing and service network covering over 40 cities nationwide, including key regions such as North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northeast, Northwest, and Southwest China. It also has an international presence with exports to countries in Asia, Europe, and South America. Production facilities are located in Shenzhen and subsidiaries in Shijiazhuang, Guangzhou, Chengdu, Wuhan, Changchun, Jinan, and other cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Tongye Technology operates in the midstream segment of the rail transit supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and system integration of electrical equipment for locomotives and rail vehicles. It supplies core electrical components and systems to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and rail operators, and also provides downstream maintenance and repair services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation with a strong R&D focus on developing high-reliability, intelligent, energy-efficient electrical products with independent intellectual property rights. Key R&D directions include modular power supply platforms, intelligent control units with high safety levels (SIL4), permanent magnet synchronous motors, EC fans, and hydrogen fuel cell-related power electronics. It actively collaborates with top universities and invests significantly in digital management platforms (PLM, ERP, CRM) to enhance product development and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electrical products (power supplies, intelligent controls, motors, fans, and accessories) to rail vehicle manufacturers and operators. Additionally, the company earns recurring income from maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services for rail transit electrical equipment. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales supported by a network of distributors, with contracts often awarded through bidding and competitive negotiation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the core suppliers in the rail transit electrical equipment industry in China, competing with a few specialized suppliers in various product segments. It holds a strong market position with recognized certifications (ISO 9001, ISO/TS 22163, CRCC, EN15085, SIL) and long-term partnerships with leading OEMs and operators such as China CRRC and China National Railway Group. The industry features high technical barriers and entry thresholds, and no single company dominates all product segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 424.5 million, representing an 18.31% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 49.14 million, up 37.10% year-over-year. The company’s asset base totaled about RMB 974.3 million with a net asset value of RMB 619.9 million. It maintains a steady growth trajectory supported by expanding orders, increased sales in intelligent control and motor/fan products, and stable maintenance service revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenzhen Tongye Technology differentiates itself through its deep industry expertise, comprehensive product ecosystem covering power supply, control, and execution components, and strong R&D capabilities leading to high-reliability, intelligent, and energy-efficient products. The company emphasizes customized solutions, advanced safety features like hot standby redundancy, and extensive after-sales service networks for rapid response and stable operation. Its commitment to innovation, quality certifications, and strategic partnerships with leading rail manufacturers underpin its competitive advantage.
